stations.title: Ticket office
stations.text: Waits on slow calls one by one.

captions: The board works again. Now Bram finds seat 4B still locked after an email bounced.
One failed email froze the booking, and the seat was never unlocked.
You write it with await, in three tasks.
Now the booking is saved, the bounce is noted and seat 4B is unlocked.
Less waiting, and the seat is always freed, whatever fails.
